subject: Request: Pilot shelf-life deferral & sandbox credit due to integration backlog
messages:
From: Alex Torres <alex.torres@integron.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Integron Engineering <integron-devs@integron.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot timeline blocked — need short extension and credits

Hi Vanessa / Ben,

Quick background: we hit a blocker in the webhook adapter during our staging run this morning — the third-party payload schema changed and our ingestion pipeline is failing validation. Engineering triaged it and estimates 7–10 business days to stabilize and get the connector into a deployable state. That pushes our planned demo window out and means we'll burn through the pilot sandbox credits without getting meaningful results.

Attached a small log excerpt (integration_log_snippet.txt) and the draft SOW we've been iterating on. Two asks:
- Can Redwood extend the pilot window by 2 weeks (shelf-life deferral) so we don't lose the momentum?
- Would you consider a small one-time sandbox credit top-up to cover the re-run once we fix the adapter (estimate ~25k tokens)?

We really want to keep this deal on track — we should have a fix plan by end of day tomorrow and can share a simple MRP (mitigation + rollout plan).

Thanks,
Alex Torres
VP Product
Integron

Attachment: integration_log_snippet.txt (text)
Attachment: SOW_draft_v2.pdf (pdf)
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Torres <alex.torres@integron.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2027 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot timeline blocked — need short extension and credits

Alex — thanks for the heads up and for sending the logs.

Understood on the schema drift — that’s a common snag. Quick questions so I can move this through on our side:
- Can you confirm the expected mitigation ETA (business days) and whether the fix requires any changes to the Redwood SDK or just your adapter?
- Do you have a short mutual action plan worked up? If not, I’ll send a one-page template we can use to log milestones and acceptance criteria.

Operationally I can propose a conditional 2-week shelf-life deferral, but I need Ben and Kim to confirm the credit ask and any approvals required. If you can post the MRP link (or paste the three bullet milestones in reply) by EOD tomorrow we can fast-track the internal approvals.

Also flagged this to Product & Support — copying Ben and Kim.

—Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Exec, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Alex Torres <alex.torres@integron.com>
Date: Sat, 03 Jul 2027 16:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot timeline blocked — need short extension and credits

Vanessa / Alex — looping in for approvals.

On Thu, 01 Jul 2027 at 09:04, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Alex — thanks for the heads up and for sending the logs.
> 
> Understood on the schema drift — that’s a common snag. Quick questions so I can move this through on our side: ...

Thanks for the detailed note, Alex. I’m comfortable approving a provisional 2-week extension to the pilot shelf-life to keep the POC alive. On the credit side, I can approve a one-time sandbox credit bump of 25,000 tokens (trade name: pilot-safety-net) contingent on the following:
- Integron shares the MRP with dates and the owner for each milestone.
- Engineering confirms no code changes required to Redwood SDK (adapter-only) or provides a concrete plan and timeline if SDK adjustments are needed.

Kimberly — tagging you for a quick engineering validation. Can your team confirm whether this is an adapter-only fix or if we need a small SDK patch? If adapter-only, Support will reserve the credit and extend the pilot window.

Attached is a short approval stub (approval_stub.pdf) I’ll sign once we get the MRP and engineering confirmation.

Ben Carter
Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: approval_stub.pdf (pdf)
From: Alex Torres <alex.torres@integron.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Integron Engineering <integron-devs@integron.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 07 Jul 2027 09:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot timeline blocked — need short extension and credits

Thanks — really appreciate the quick turn. Confirming:

- MRP (three bullets) — owner dates:
  1) Schema fix & unit tests (Integron Eng, ETA 2027-07-09)
  2) Staging re-run + validation (Integron Eng, ETA 2027-07-12)
  3) Rescheduled demo + acceptance (Product, ETA 2027-07-21)

- This is an adapter-only change; no changes to Redwood SDK.
- We accept the conditional 25k token sandbox top-up and the provisional 2-week shelf-life deferral.

Can you confirm the effective new pilot end-date on your side once the extension is applied? Also, Integron Engineering requests a short on-call window during the rollout (2 hours) to coordinate cutover.

Appreciate the partnership — we’ll be ready for the demo on 2027-07-21 and will share a quick post-mortem after the run.

Best,
Alex Torres
VP Product
Integron
Integron Engineering: integron-devs@integron.com
